brief.objective: Minimize closest_lady_distance^2 + 1e6/(closest_guard_distance+0.1) within 240 s. The Lady-distance term dominates: holding 2600 m costs about 6.8e6, while a 150 m Guard pass costs only about 6.7e3. Drive hard toward the Lady and accept a moderate-distance pass around the Guard, but never let the Guard inside about 100 m.
brief.approach: Accelerate early along +y toward the Lady and build a radial offset of roughly 300-400 m during the first 40-60 s, so the line of travel passes the Guard (at y about -600 m and closing) to the side rather than head-on. Use EVADE_GUARD only when the predicted Guard miss distance drops below the keepout. Otherwise prefer APPROACH_LADY or GO_TO_WAYPOINT with offset waypoints, since a sideways sidestep that keeps closing on the Lady is better than retreating. Once past the Guard, swing back to the Lady's track and brake along the glide slope to reach within 5 m. If the Guard re-blocks, still keep the Lady range shrinking, because every 100 m gained near the Lady is worth far more than Guard margin above about 150 m. Watch fuel: about 250 m/s total, so do not exceed about 20 m/s closing speed and avoid repeated large velocity reversals.
phases: T0-10s: burn along-track toward the Lady while adding radial offset (waypoint about [+350, -1500, 0]); begin closing at 12-18 m/s

10-90s: flank pass. Keep the radial offset, pass the Guard with predicted miss of 150 m or more, and use EVADE_GUARD only if the predicted miss falls below 150 m or the Guard closes faster than 15 m/s inside 400 m
90-180s: post-pass. Steer back toward Lady-relative [0, 0, 0] with APPROACH_LADY at up to 20 m/s, re-evaluating Guard geometry every tactical cycle
180-240s: terminal. Brake on the glide slope to 2 m/s inside 50 m to reach within 5 m of the Lady; if the Guard threatens within 100 m, sidestep radially without opening the Lady range
Contingency: if fuel falls below 12%, COAST on the best Lady-closing trajectory and use the remaining fuel only for last-ditch Guard evasion
